title: The neo-euhemerist method
statement: The corpus's working method is the neo-euhemerist reading: the gods and divine beings of myth as garbled memory of real historical figures, extending Euhemerus's gods-as-kings by identifying those figures as a technologically advanced civilization whose capabilities looked supernatural to the recorders — operationalized in the corpus by Sendy's five reader-conditions (what the reader must have: the text, astronautics, the sciences, refusal of the supernatural, an intelligible universe) and Biglino's three-step procedure (what the reader must do: the original language, tradition set aside, the literal reading), and extended beyond both by the precessional architecture and the ongoing-alliance frame; the Elohim-civilization hypothesis is this method's output, not its premise.

includes: The method-identity claim: the corpus stands, self-aware, in the euhemerist lineage — the substitution that defines the neo- extension (advanced visitors for exceptional kings) named as a substitution

The operative pairing as the corpus's contemporary hermeneutic: Sendy supplies the reader's equipment, Biglino the procedure — with Sendy's fourth condition (refusal of explanation by the inexplicable) as the method's philosophical spine
The corpus's two declared extensions beyond the inherited method: the precessional architecture and the alliance read as ongoing rather than remembered
The order of operations that keeps the method honest: the hypothesis (woh-claim-0001) is the method's output; where the method fails a text, the text wins
excludes: Any claim of academic standing for the method; mainstream scholarship engages the position as the paleocontact hypothesis and rejects it, and classical Euhemerism is a study-object, not a live method — both registered as stated
The content claims the method produces, which live in their own records
Sendy's and Biglino's own larger programs beyond the borrowed equipment and procedure
Any softening of the category-substitution objection, which the corpus's own articles state at full strength before applying the method

source_references.locator: Chapter 18, the hologram passage: the four stated conditions and the implicit fifth (the French text as excerpted and translated in the corpus's own entry)
The three-step operative procedure (original text, tradition set aside, literal reading) as the corpus registers it
Feder's standard critique of paleocontact reasoning, carried as the method's mainstream assessment

alternatives.statement: The method substitutes one unexplained category (visitors) for another (gods) and calls the substitution explanation; nothing in the texts selects garbled memory of technology over the mythographers' own accounts of what myth is.

Sendy's conditions pre-load the verdict: a reader required to refuse the supernatural and equipped with astronautics will find astronautics; the equipment manufactures the coherence it claims to reveal.

revision_triggers: The founder elevates the method's framework relation beyond contextual (accepted at contextual by ADR 0006; the corpus entry's 'foundational method' phrasing remains descriptive).
Claim woh-claim-0001 is revised in a way that changes what the method outputs.
The corpus's methodology entries change the stated equipment, procedure, or extensions.
